text:
mike: Heads up — seeing a token-processing tail spike on /v1/generate (model=redwood-13b-qa) starting ~12:40 UTC. p99 token latency ~3x normal. dashboard: https://dash/redwood/perf?panel=token-waterfall&route=/v1/generate

perf-bot: ALERT: LATENCY_BURN_RATE on /v1/generate model=redwood-13b-qa window=5m burn=2.3x threshold=1.5x

anya: I think this lines up with the kernel-selector change that landed last night (PR #5423). It prefers fused-kv for seq>1024. Can we get kernel-selection counts for the route?

ken: kv-cache TTL was lowered in the canary from 15m -> 5m last week (config change #configs-811). That could increase refills and make fused kernels worse due to extra memcpy. Quick read: kv_cache.miss_rate p99 jumped 0.7% -> 3.6% on the same window.

zach: If burn_rate > 2x we should page SRE. @oncall-sre can you ack and triage? :rotating_light: 

oncall-sre: Acked, paging now. Please attach a flamegraph or `perf` sample for the slow requests.

mike: Uploading a short perf snippet from a sampled slow request:

```
perf top -p <pid>
  28.7% fused_kernel_dispatch
  16.2% cudaMemcpyAsync
  9.4% attention_kernel_generic
  5.1% nvtx_range_end
```

anya: That profile smells like kernel selection thrashing + extra memcopies from fused_kv path on medium-length sequences. Also noticed our batching heuristic (batcher_v2) recently changed its target calculation; with KV misses batch sizes collapsed which amplifies p99. Two quick mitigations: 1) rollback the selector change, 2) set route-level runtime.override_kernel=generic. Hotfix #1 is faster.

ken: I'll also revert kv-ttl to 15m in canary to reduce refills and observe. Opening PR now.

mike: Created canary config: override kernel -> `generic` for /v1/generate (canary rollout 10% on DC-us-east1) and kv-ttl=15m. Monitoring metrics.

perf-bot: UPDATE: LATENCY_BURN_RATE now 1.05x (5m). p99 trending down.

lisa: Nice work. Follow-ups: add a dashboard tile breaking down p95/p99 by kernel_type per-route and an attribution SLI that links p99 regressions to kernel selection + kv-miss ratio so we can avoid firefights like this.

mike: Will write up a short postmortem + attach before/after flamegraphs. Closing thread unless it reoccurs. :white_check_mark:
